request.style: English, male baritone solo with warm choir backing, acoustic piano, acoustic guitar, cymbals, strings, gentle drum, reverent and joyful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They brought the ark of God inside the tent
David had pitched it for the covenant
Before God they offered burnt offerings
And peace offerings for the nation

[Verse]
When the work was done he blessed the people
In the name of the Lord most high
To every man and woman in Israel
He gave bread meat and raisin cake

[Chorus]
Give thanks to the LORD call on his name
Make known among the nations what he has done
Sing to him sing praise to him
Tell of all his wonderful works

[Verse]
He appointed Asaph and the Levites
To minister before the ark of God
With harps and lyres they played the music
While trumpets sounded out his word

[Chorus]
Give thanks to the LORD call on his name
Make known among the nations what he has done
Sing to him sing praise to him
Tell of all his wonderful works

[Bridge]
Remember his covenant forever
The word he commanded for a thousand generations
He is the LORD our God
His judgments fill the whole earth

[Outro]
David returned home to bless his household
And all the people said amen praise the Lord
